changeinfo.changes: * Added support for Traditional Chinese. * Fixed rare crash when playing for a long time. * Fixed rare crash in menus. * Resolved the issue of the store sometimes being empty when pressing Downloadable Content from the Main Menu. * Resolved the issue of sometimes saves being disabled when buying the full game from the trial. * Resolved the issue of two prompts appearing on the Capilli after giving him the shovel in the Monastery. * Resolved the issue of the Golem sometimes not appearing. * Improved an issue where Igniculus is unable to blind enemies if the player keeps the left stick pointing left or right on the transition to battle. * Resolved an issue where Igniculus could get stuck when activating a puzzle element through the touch screen. * Changed Normal and Hard mode names to Casual and Expert. * Resolved an issue where text read Controller 2 instead of Controller 1 for Igniculus single player controls. * Resolved some issues with Nox' appearance.

* Fixed rare crashes when entering battles * Resolved the issue of the ‘Downloadable Content’ option not functionning properly. * Resolved the issue that, when playing in Trial mode with Uplay linked account, opening Menu screen by pressing OPTION will unlock Uplay Rewards * Fixed an error when selecting the "Unlock full game" option when selected from main menu * Resolved an issue of cinematics not triggering again if the game is closed while the cinematic is being played (Medusa) * Resolved the issue that, when in the Monastery, the Player is unable to advance when box is moved to puzzle trigger and continue is selected after auto save. * Fixed an issue during battles; animation of selected enemy's icon in action barweres displayed even if the game is paused * Resolved an issue with the World Map becoming unlocked after fleeing the fight with the Medusa twice (Well Area). * Fixed a spawning issue after quitting and relaunching the game; the player would end up going into battle right after respawning. * Updated a missing chest in the secret area of the Windmill section * Resolved an issue where Aurora falls out of map when arriving to the Palace of Lemuria for a second time from the World Map and after defeating the black queen * Resolved the issue when on Trial mode, SCE trade mark is used but legal notice is not displayed. * Resolved an issue when battle music could be heard in menu opened by pressing the PS button. * Fixed a music loop issue in the Well when defeating a specific enemy. * Fixed a looping sound issue heard in the background of a battle outside of the Monastery * Resolved the issue of text overlaping the frame when user buys DLCs from in-game * Fixed Gen and Drust's interaction button prompts that would fail to disappear after completing the quest in the Piscean Village. * Fixed a Credits issue: Debug text observed when skipping the credits after completing the walkthrough * Resolved an issue when entering the Pause Menu during fights where animation would not pause * Added an option in the options Menu to turn off the tutorial * Fixed an issue with the Level Up screen that could reset if pausing/returning to gameplay at a specific time * Resolved graphical glitches on Nox that can occasionnaly occur in Palace of the Sun * Fixed an improper animation of Aurora while dashing * Resolved an issue for VFX that stop playing when using multiple buffs and debuffs in battle. * Fixed an issue with Aurora in navigation when landing on the ground. * Fixed a transition bug where Aurora was seen walking in the air if the player would try to transition while flying. * Fixed a looping animation issue with the Trunk Crawler enemy when the player would stand close to it * Fixed a navigation issue with Aurora when entering a tower in the Windmill area * Polished behavior of Aurora Teen / Adult hair * Updated the cloth outline for Aurora Teen and Adult
